name: ESWP Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: The promotion's top title, changing hands twice at its own shows in the spring of 1996 before settling on a champion who carried it into 1997.

name: ESWP North American Championship
epitaph: A regional singles title defended twice in the promotion's surviving record, its second reign ending in a title shot broken up before the bell.

name: ESWP World Tag Team Championship
epitaph: Crowned at the promotion's own first pay-per-view and defended once more in this record, with no further change documented.

name: ESWP World Women's Championship
epitaph: Crowned at the promotion's own first pay-per-view and changed hands two weeks later, the only women's singles title recorded changing hands in this run.

name: ESWP World Women's Tag Team Championship
epitaph: Crowned at the promotion's own first pay-per-view, changing hands at least twice more by January 1997 without a surviving document for the middle change.

name: ESWP Women's Television Championship
epitaph: Defended successfully once in this record; its own start is not documented.

name: ESWP Television Championship
epitaph: Vacated when its holder moved up to the Heavyweight title, then won by tournament in the same broadcast.

name: ESWP North American Women's Championship
epitaph: Defended successfully once by disqualification before its holder gave it up to chase a bigger title, per the promotion's own later billing.

name: ESWP European Championship
epitaph: Contested in a 1997 tournament held partly on a sibling federation's own broadcasts, changing hands twice more that year per that federation's own corroborating billing.

name: ESWP European Tag Team Championship
epitaph: Held jointly by two of the promotion's own 1997 stars, per a sibling federation's own corroborating billing.

name: ESWP Junior Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: Created for a 1997 tournament staged jointly with a sibling federation, whose own broadcasts crowned and corroborate its first champion.
